scope: Single-robot Gate-0 replacement boundary, with multi-robot topics inventoried but not frozen.

source_binding.local_source_status: Original M-TARE source is not present in the project tree; it was inspected read-only inside the pinned running image.

system_boundary.replacement_unit: The ROS node tare_planner/tare_planner_node in namespace /sensor_coverage_planner.
system_boundary.important_name_distinction: The internal M-TARE class local_coverage_planner is part of tare_planner_node and is replaced. The standalone CMU package local_planner (nodes localPlanner and pathFollower) is retained.
retained_components: vehicleSimulator state estimation and registered-scan publication
robot, LiDAR, speed, collision and local-planner parameters
replaced_components: tare_planner_node rolling occupancy and planning representation
M-TARE keypose/grid/global roadmap used for exploration
frontier/viewpoint generation and coverage state inside tare_planner_node
global subspace routing and goal selection
the internal TARE local-coverage path optimization that precedes /way_point
eventual multi-robot exploration allocation inside tare_planner_node
system_boundary.handoff: The replacement planner publishes a map-frame global goal on /way_point. The retained standalone localPlanner converts that goal plus /terrain_map into a collision-checked vehicle-frame /path; pathFollower converts /path into /cmd_vel.
system_boundary.not_replaced: The project is not replacing low-level motion planning, obstacle avoidance, terrain analysis, state estimation, sensing, or control in Gate 0-6.

interfaces.semantics: Causal LiDAR returns registered into the map frame; this is the raw geometric source for the future student representation.
Pose synchronized to registered scans; scan and odometry timestamps must differ by no more than 0.25 s in the existing adapter.

interfaces.consumer: replacement feasibility/recovery adapter and retained localPlanner
interfaces.semantics: Terrain-classified local map used by the retained local planner. It may be used for hard feasibility, but is not silently added as a neural input channel without a Gate-1 data contract.
Longer-range terrain memory consumed by original TARE. Whether V3 must consume it is a freeze decision, because doing so changes available global geometry.
Candidate collision-free local paths. Original TARE treats two consecutive empty messages as a terrain-map clearing trigger. A richer rejection identity is not encoded in this message.
Optional benchmark boundary; tunnel launch disables it by default. If enabled, both methods must receive the same polygon.

interfaces.consumer: retained localPlanner and optional replacement global feasibility adapter
interfaces.semantics: Virtual obstacles are already enforced by the retained local planner. Global consumption is optional but must be identical between methods if used.
Absolute map-frame x/y/z global lookahead goal. localPlanner ignores header.frame_id and numerically compares x/y with /state_estimation, so frame correctness must be enforced by the producer.
Original behavior publishes 8.0 after two consecutive empty /free_paths messages. The old semantic node omitted this recovery path.
Namespaced original completion signal. The exact V3 completion criterion is not frozen and the old semantic node did not publish it.
Per-cycle planning runtime in seconds. Equivalent measurement boundaries for Python/GPU inference versus original C++ planning remain to be frozen.
Collision-checked local path; this is downstream of the replacement boundary and must remain identical between methods.
Low-level command; neither learning nor global topology may bypass this controller in the fair comparison.
Shares cells, roadmap edges, global/local cell IDs, robot positions and update ages. This is inventory only; V3 semantic-topology allocation schema is deferred to Gate 7.
Robot position broadcast for communication and allocation; single-robot Gate 0 does not activate it.

fairness_invariants: Only one process may publish /way_point in a closed-loop run.
Original TARE and the replacement use identical simulator image, world hash, spawn, robot count, LiDAR, terrain analysis, localPlanner, pathFollower and runtime budget.
Both methods receive the same causal sensor and terrain streams; strict-test assets never enter training, SSL, normalization, teacher calibration, threshold tuning or checkpoint selection.
Recovery behavior driven by empty /free_paths and /map_clearing is common code or behaviorally matched.
Completion and runtime outputs are recorded under an identical measurement contract.
Shadow mode may run beside TARE but must not publish /way_point or mutate planner state.
old_semantic_node_gaps: It consumed only /registered_scan and /state_estimation_at_scan, not /terrain_map, /terrain_map_ext or /free_paths.
It published /way_point but omitted original recovery /map_clearing, completion /exploration_finish and /runtime outputs.
Its eight-second target watchdog inferred failure from odometry progress rather than explicit local-planner target rejection.
Its run script recorded only scan and odometry, so local path, waypoint, command, recovery and node-health failures cannot be fully reconstructed.
unresolved_before_freeze: Decide whether /terrain_map_ext is a required common global-planner input or excluded from both methods' decision interface.
Define a target-identified local-planner accept/reject feedback message; /free_paths emptiness alone cannot associate failure with a graph edge.
Freeze exploration completion semantics and timeout behavior.
Freeze equivalent CPU/GPU runtime measurement boundaries.
Vendor or export the audited upstream source snapshot because the project currently contains only the Docker image binding and hashes.
Design the multi-robot semantic topology message only at Gate 7; do not claim this partial inventory is frozen.
